Funky Barn.name: Funky Barn
Funky Barn.summary: It’s Farming! but not as you know it... Grab your Wii U GamePad and create a beautiful farmland full of animals, crops, trees and more… then develop it into the craziest, most offbeat farm imaginable, overflowing with the whackiest contraptions and goofiest gizmos you and your animals have ever seen!
